<?php

namespace App\Policies;

use App\Models\User;
use App\Models\Contact; // Import the Contact model

class ContactPolicy
{
    public function viewAny(User $user): bool
    {
        return true; // Allow viewing any contact by anyone
    }

    public function view(User $user, Contact $model): bool
    {
        return $user->id === $model->user_id; // Only allow viewing the contact if it belongs to the same user
    }

    public function create(User $user): bool
    {
        return true; // Allow creating a contact by anyone
    }

    public function update(User $user, Contact $model): bool
    {
        return $user->id === $model->user_id; // Only allow updating the contact if it belongs to the same user
    }

    public function delete(User $user, Contact $model): bool
    {
        return $user->id === $model->user_id; // Only allow deleting the contact if it belongs to the same user
    }
}
